blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — With the year winding down, Filipinos are wasting little time turning their holiday travel wish lists into booked trips. Filipino travelers are shaping their trips around outdoor adventures, seasonal attractions and live entertainment, based on data from online leisure and travel booking platform Klook.
